column1: # RFC 0042 Stage 2 evidence — equal-width occupancy predicate (freeze item 4)
# Commands:
#   bigshark-subgame-nash-conv --rfc0042-occupancy fixture
#   bigshark-subgame-nash-conv --rfc0042-occupancy full
# Boards: the two W1 gated-shape fixture boards (2c3d7hJs9c river
#         2c3d7hJs turn)
# Statistic: holdings per K/4-wide mega-bin (four equity quartiles of
#            width 0.25); ratio = fullest / emptiest mega-bin.
# Rule (RFC 0042 freeze item 4): switch the primary point to
#   equal-mass ONLY if ratio > 5 on a majority of boards.
# Two scopes are reported:
# - fixture-range: the 10-hand enumerable training range filtered to
#   non-blocked holdings (8 river / 10 turn). The statistic is vacuous
#   at that size: the two extreme quartiles are empty on both boards
#   (ratio infinite) purely because 8-10 samples cannot cover four
#   quartiles. This cannot be evidence about bin geometry.
# - full-nonblocked: every holding compatible with the board
#   width bins is a property of the board's equity distribution
#   independent of which range the solver enumerates; this is the
#   meaningful reference population and is pinned as the predicate's
#   reference set in the Stage 2 freeze addendum (pending independent
#   approval). Both boards are below 5x (1.129
#   trigger -> the equal-width primary point RETAINS.
